claim: `plane.set({ pan: undefined })` is accepted and makes every later draw of the plane throw
A bare-number `bleed` widens only the x axis, so a lattice tiled on both axes pops content in at its top and bottom edges
Mutating the live options object returned by get changes drawing without notifying subscribers, and a later set with the mutated value is silent

triage.scenario: Create a plane with pan {x: 0, y: 1}, subscribe, then set pan.x = 1 on the object get returns: the next draw uses the new pan, no subscriber hears of it, and a later set with that pan is silent too
triage.cause: get exposes the internal mutable snapshot

triage.scenario: Period 100, positive canvas size, x scale 1, y scale 0: viewportWorldRect reports infinite height, but the count and safe-integer checks accept the lattice and a callback runs for each horizontal copy under the invalid view
triage.cause: untiled-axis short-circuit bypasses the degenerate-view guard
